description:
RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-chat-server --no-deps fails with broken-intra-doc-link at backend.rs:438:

```
error: unresolved link to `crate::memory::MemoryBackend`
   --> crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs:438:25
    |
438 |     /// The reference [`crate::memory::MemoryBackend`] does NOT
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ no item named `memory` in module `jmap_chat_server`
```

The `memory` module is gated behind feature='memory'. Rustdoc with default-features fails the intra-doc-link resolution. `cargo doc --all-features` succeeds.

Analogous to existing beads:
- JMAP-cs2o (jmap-metadata-server lib.rs:50)
- JMAP-go45 / JMAP-9b7r (jmap-filenode-server)
- JMAP-m1yd (jmap-sharing-server principal.rs)

Fix shape (matching the sibling pattern): wrap the rustdoc reference with `#[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(feature = \"memory\")))]` style, or use a fully-qualified path with intra-doc-link disabled, or rewrite the link to a plain identifier (e.g. `MemoryBackend` without backticks) so it doesn't trigger broken-link resolution.

Discovered during JMAP-x2gd.82 work; not caused by that bead's changes (verified by git stash + retry on main HEAD).

Engineering basis: rustdoc -D warnings is a workspace pre-commit gate per AGENTS.md. The pre-existing breakage means `cargo doc -p jmap-chat-server --no-deps` cannot succeed under default-features today.
title: jmap-chat-server: rustdoc broken-intra-doc-link at backend.rs:438 referencing crate::memory::MemoryBackend behind feature gate
